Compute headroom ratio
headroom_ratio = free_slots / reserved

last_trigger < now − 30 min
(per region + CRG type)?

span.p:
Create CapacityIncreaseRequest
writes OperationRecord →
escalates to quota / capacity subsystem

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Configurable thresholds (PlacementPolicy, remaining-headroom %):
prod_autoincrease_threshold = 0.20
nonprod_autoincrease_threshold = 0.20
dr_autoincrease_threshold = 0.35 (higher — DR is lean bootstrap)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reconciliation floor vs threshold:
Floor = Allocated + Buffer is the minimum the CRG must always reserve.
The threshold is the EARLY-WARNING signal that fires above that floor.
